text:
Ana: quick alert 1: host p95 for HTTP2 streaming small-reqs climbed ~45ms after yesterday's kernel picker change.

Tom: any traces? pattern?

Ana: small payloads dominated: lots of <=48B frames, many writev calls. Repro: `wrk --threads 4 --connections 100 --script smallframe.lua http2://ingress:443/stream`.

Ying: saw similar on bench. Perf shows `writev` with 12 iovecs avg and `kvcache::miss` spikes. KV hit rate drops to ~20%.

Ana: pushed a tiny canary `fix/ingress-coalesce-adaptive` that flips coalesce_on_write back on when avg_iovecs>3 and adjusts kernel threshold from 120->70 for streaming routes. CI green.

ci-bot: ci/build 1402 passed :white_check_mark: https://ci.internal/1402

Tom: run ablation? selector-only vs coalesce-only?

Ana: did 10m runs: selector-only p95 -8ms, coalesce-only p95 -48ms, both -55ms. kvcache hits: base 26% -> coalesce 86% -> both 90%.

Ying: good signal. Also add `ingress.frame_size_hist` metric so Optimize can auto-detect client-side small-frame sources.

Tom: agree. Add unit tests for selector bins. If coalescing causes any tail for large batches we'll catch in perf suite.

Ana: rolling canary now, will post flamegraphs + socket counters once steady. Ping for access.
